whatYouGet.zh-Hant: GitLab Ultimate 功能（SaaS 或自架）與 50,000 分鐘運算時間；不含官方技術支援
whatYouGet.zh-Hans: GitLab Ultimate 功能（SaaS 或自建）与 50,000 分钟计算时间；不含官方技术支持
whatYouGet.en: GitLab Ultimate features (SaaS or self-managed) plus 50,000 compute minutes; no vendor support included

whyItHelps.zh-Hant: 用頂級方案的安全掃描、合規與規劃功能管理專案，CI 額度也更充裕。
whyItHelps.zh-Hans: 用顶级方案的安全扫描、合规与规划功能管理项目，CI 额度也更充裕。
whyItHelps.en: Run the project with Ultimate's security scanning, compliance and planning tools, with far more CI minutes.

requirements.zh-Hant: namespace 內每個專案都要採 OSI 認可授權；GitLab.com 群組或自架實例與原始碼都必須公開；每年需續約
requirements.zh-Hans: namespace 内每个项目都要采用 OSI 认可的许可证；GitLab.com 群组或自建实例与源代码都必须公开；每年需续约
requirements.en: Every project in the namespace must use an OSI-approved license; the GitLab.com group or self-managed instance and the source code must be public; renew annually
